8.
Every appointed member of the Commission shall,
unless  he  vacates  office  earlier  by  death,  resignation  or
removal, hold office for a period of three years from the date
of his appointment and shall, unless he has been removed
from office be eligible for re-appointment for not more than
one further term, whether consecutive or otherwise.
